name: Pushpagiri Medical College Hospital
tagline: NABH‑accredited tertiary teaching hospital and multispeciality centre in Thiruvalla
summary: Pushpagiri Medical College Hospital is a NABH‑accredited, 678‑bed teaching and multispeciality hospital in Thiruvalla offering wide surgical and super‑specialty services and 24/7 emergency care.
description: Pushpagiri Medical College Hospital (PMCH) is the teaching hospital of Pushpagiri Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre in Thiruvalla, Pathanamthitta; it is NABH‑accredited with a defined scope covering many surgical and super‑specialty services. ([portal.nabh.co](https://portal.nabh.co/Documents/AccreditedList/Hospitals/H-2024-1313_5th%20Edition.pdf))

The hospital is a large multidisciplinary centre (commonly cited as a 678‑bed facility) serving central Travancore with inpatient, outpatient, emergency and critical care services. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pushpagiri_Medical_College?utm_source=openai))

The medical college began in 2002 and grows from a mission hospital that began as an eight‑bedded clinic in 1959; Pushpagiri combines clinical care with undergraduate, postgraduate and super‑specialty training. ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/storage/4705/Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf))

PMCH emphasises quality systems (NABH and NABL certifications, digital accreditation and department‑level quality recognitions) and hosts specialties from cardiology and neurosurgery to surgical gastroenterology and renal transplant services. ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/storage/4705/Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf))
highlights: Large multidisciplinary teaching hospital (commonly cited as 678 beds). ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pushpagiri_Medical_College?utm_source=openai))

Wide surgical and super‑specialty scope including CVTS, neurosurgery, surgical gastroenterology, renal transplant and more. ([portal.nabh.co](https://portal.nabh.co/Documents/AccreditedList/Hospitals/H-2024-1313_5th%20Edition.pdf))
NABL‑accredited virology lab and multiple department quality certifications (noted in the 2025–26 annual report). ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/storage/4705/Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf))

Active academic programmes: MBBS, MD/MS, DM, DNB and MCh courses; hospital integrates education, research and community projects. ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/news-and-events/pimsrc-re-accredited-with-a-grade-under-kuhs-quality-assurance-system))

sections.heading: Background
body: Pushpagiri began as a small clinic for maternal and newborn care (an eight‑bed clinic founded in 1959) and expanded into a full medical college and hospital; the college (PIMSRC) started MBBS training in 2002. The institution is run by Pushpagiri Medical Society and links mission hospital work with professional medical education. ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/storage/4705/Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf))

Over decades the campus added nursing, pharmacy, dental and allied health programmes and a dedicated research centre; the annual report (2025–26) summarises these developments and quality achievements. ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/storage/4705/Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf))

sections.heading: Clinical services and specialties
body: PMCH is accredited by NABH with a published scope that lists broad clinical services (anaesthesiology, cardiology including interventional cardiology, cardiothoracic & vascular surgery, critical care, neurosurgery, nephrology & dialysis, kidney transplant, medical and surgical gastroenterology, surgical oncology, paediatrics & neonatology, orthopaedics including joint replacement, plastic surgery, ENT, ophthalmology and many others). Diagnostic and lab services (MRI, CT, DSA, endoscopy, molecular biology) and allied professions (physiotherapy, dietetics, occupational therapy) are included in the NABH scope. ([portal.nabh.co](https://portal.nabh.co/Documents/AccreditedList/Hospitals/H-2024-1313_5th%20Edition.pdf))

The hospital also documents NABL accreditation for its virology testing and department‑level quality certifications (endoscopy, CSSD, digital standards) in its Annual Report 2025–26. These reflect a sustained institutional focus on laboratory and infection‑control quality. ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/storage/4705/Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf))

sections.heading: Education, research and community
body: As the teaching hospital of Pushpagiri Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre, PMCH supports MBBS, MD/MS, DM, MCh and DNB programmes and allied health training; it hosts a medical education unit, skills lab, research centre and community training projects. ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/news-and-events/pimsrc-re-accredited-with-a-grade-under-kuhs-quality-assurance-system))

The Pushpagiri Research Centre and Centre for Virology (NABL scope) are part of the campus research infrastructure; the annual report lists research activity, community health projects and training centres that connect clinical care with outreach. ([pimsrc.edu.in](https://www.pimsrc.edu.in/storage/4705/Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf))

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Location and hours: PMCH is on the Pushpagiri campus in Thiruvalla (MC Road / near the private bus stand) and advertises 24/7 emergency services; out‑patient and specialty clinic hours vary—confirm appointments and clinic timings before travel. ([pathanamthitta.nic.in](https://pathanamthitta.nic.in/en/public-utility/pushpagiri-medical-college/?utm_source=openai))

Appointments & insurance: the hospital accepts scheduled appointments and lists phone/email contacts on its site; if you use health insurance or an empanelled scheme, confirm pre‑authorization and empanelment status before planned procedures. Confirm specialty availability and any procedural prerequisites directly with the hospital. ([pushpagiri.in](https://www.pushpagiri.in/contact?utm_source=openai))

Access & parking: the campus has on‑site parking at the Pushpagiri Medicity area; a GPS overlay on institutional documents places the campus near Perumthuruthy with coordinates around lat 9.411 and long 76.556 (confirm with your map app). ([pharmacycollege.pushpagiri.net](https://pharmacycollege.pushpagiri.net/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/4.1.1-Infrastructure-facilities.pdf?utm_source=openai))

latest.text: Pushpagiri Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre (PIMSRC) re‑accredited with A+ Grade under KUHS Quality Assurance System for 2026–2029 (inspection Apr 22, 2026; award date Jul 13, 2026).
Annual Report 2025–26 published (report covers July 2025–June 2026) with details of NABH full accreditation (Jan 2024), NABH Digital (Jun 2024) and NABL scopes for the Centre for Virology.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Open year‑round; emergency services 24/7—check outpatient clinic hours and specialist availability before visiting.
visitorInfo.howToReach: By road: on MC Road near Thiruvalla town and private bus stand; Thiruvalla KSRTC/Private bus terminus is nearby. By rail: Thiruvalla railway station serves the town (use local taxi/auto to campus). Confirm directions with the hospital contact. ([pathanamthitta.nic.in](https://pathanamthitta.nic.in/en/public-utility/pushpagiri-medical-college/?utm_source=openai))
etiquette: Call ahead to book specialist OPD or surgery dates; many departments require appointments or referrals.
Carry government ID, previous medical records, and a list of medications when attending clinics or admissions.
If using insurance or government schemes, confirm empanelment and pre‑authorization procedures before planned admissions.
Allow extra travel time during monsoon season; parking is available on campus but can be busy—ask about visitor parking.
